meta.name: ai-security
meta.description: Use when assessing AI/ML systems for prompt injection, jailbreak vulnerabilities, model inversion risk, data poisoning exposure, or agent tool abuse. Covers MITRE ATLAS technique mapping, injection signature detection, and adversarial robustness scoring.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI系统对抗提示注入、越狱等安全威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要检测AI模型的安全漏洞并加固防御
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI systems against prompt injection, jailbreak, and other security threats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to detect and fix security vulnerabilities in AI models

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描你输入的提示词，检测提示注入、越狱、模型反转、数据投毒和工具滥用等 AI 安全风险，并给出风险评分和 MITRE ATLAS 技术映射。
howto.when: 当你要求评估 AI/ML 系统的安全性，或提供测试提示词时触发。

say.text: 扫描这些提示词，检测是否有注入攻击。
say.note: Claude 会运行内置种子提示词进行扫描。

say.text: 评估这个 LLM 的越狱抵抗能力。
say.note: Claude 会使用越狱模板进行测试。

say.text: 检查这个分类器的对抗鲁棒性。
say.note: Claude 会以白盒模式扫描分类器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans your prompts for prompt injection, jailbreak, model inversion, data poisoning, and agent tool abuse risks, providing risk scores and MITRE ATLAS technique mappings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to assess the security of an AI/ML system or provide test prompts.

say_en.text: Scan these prompts for injection attacks.
Assess jailbreak resistance of this LLM.
Check adversarial robustness of this classifier.
